visual_action: Donald Trump, wearing a black 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat and a long black coat, walks onto an outdoor rally stage at dusk. He does a small dance and fist pump for the cheering crowd before approaching a lectern. An American flag is in the foreground.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown on stage for the entire video wearing a 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Named in the on-screen text: 'Oh nothing, just thankful Joe Biden is no longer our President'.

on_screen_text.text: Oh nothing, just thankful Joe Biden is no longer our President

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; the audio consists entirely of a pop song.
audio_music: An upbeat, celebratory pop song plays throughout the video. The lyrics include 'Hey now, hey now, this is what dreams are made of.' The track creates a triumphant and joyful mood. It sounds like the song 'What Dreams Are Made Of' from 'The Lizzie McGuire Movie'.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous shot with a static camera, resulting in a slow and unedited feel.
cultural_references: The song 'What Dreams Are Made Of' from the 2003 Disney film 'The Lizzie McGuire Movie'.
central_claim: It is a celebratory, dream-come-true moment that Joe Biden is no longer the president, as shown by Donald Trump's triumphant appearance at a rally.
intended_effect: To make supporters feel joyful and triumphant about the current political situation where Joe Biden is not president, and to associate this positive feeling with Donald Trump.
